Class ResearcherDecorator

java.lang.Object
project.models.actors.User
project.patterns.ResearcherDecorator
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Researcher, JournalObserver
public class ResearcherDecorator extends User implements Researcher
Decorator (Decorator pattern) that adds researcher capabilities to any User. Stored in the database in place of the original user — all state is delegated to the wrapped user so identity and equality remain the same.
